title: OligoVigil: a curator-verified, source-anchored database of safety and off-target evidence for therapeutic oligonucleotides (v1.0.0)
description:
OligoVigil v1.0.0 release. A curator-verified, source-anchored knowledge base of preclinical safety and sequence-independent off-target evidence for therapeutic oligonucleotides (ASO, siRNA, PMO, LNA, aptamer, GalNAc-siRNA). The release contains 737 human-adjudicated records (626 toxicity endpoints + 111 off-target observations) from 628 primary sources, each anchored to an exact in-source location and graded A/B/C, plus a leakage-aware 344-record evaluation benchmark (toxicity 263 = 218/23/22; off-target 81 = 66/5/10) with deterministic prior baselines. The v6 within-team collaborator round (2026-06-07) added 48 curator-verified records with new chemistry and delivery dimensions, recovered 110 distinct molecule names, reduced placeholder benchmark contamination from 31.1% to 4.1%, and conducted a pilot second-curator review of 100 release rows. The v6.1 round (2026-06-07d) added a further 32 toxicity records (EXPAND-2) and a 100-row mixed-sample inter-rater study with an independent second curator: binary Cohen kappa = 0.34 (fair, per Landis-Koch); the second curator is systematically stricter than the curator of record (a safety-conservative direction).

Released alongside a candidate-to-release firewall audit trail (no machine output is presented as human curation), 1,345 demoted machine-proposed candidates, the v2 LLM-vs-human per-candidate decision triple (n = 2,003) for full reproducibility, full curation_audit, and a no-login web portal with documented REST API + OpenAPI + MCP + Bioschemas JSON-LD + W3C PROV interfaces. Companion NAR Database Issue manuscript: [TBD: DOI].
